name: rancher-rke2-codex
description: Codex client plugin for a TLS-protected Rancher/RKE2 MCP server with secret references, non-mutating preflight, and approval-gated Rancher/RKE2 component workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Plan and operate Rancher/RKE2 through one MCP server.
interface.longDescription: Provides a main orchestration skill, five thin component skills, diagnostics, runbook generation, secret-reference policy, and client-side hooks for the Rancher/RKE2 domain MCP server.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $rancher-rke2-orchestrate to validate my configuration and produce a redacted execution plan before making changes.
